svg.title: MISWAY Drift 3D narrative set design blueprint
svg.desc: Topology-derived 2D blueprint for the Drift 3D world. World x runs left to right, world z runs bottom to top, and the map is laid out from the Entry threshold into the four eras with corridors, node protections, landmark scaffolds and track-level scene cues.

g.text: 3D: dark cave, lambda gate, bright backplate, open throat
3D: canals, robot crowd, jazz alley, metro / office pressure
3D: summit, jump, travel, choice, fading line, open breath
3D: comfort loop, hidden seam, zero, time fracture, color return
3D: pit, ice, well, overload, storm lamp, office, mirror, dim city

g.title: Entry Node — threshold — non-playable — birth-side origin
A WALK IN ZEELAND — Birth Yard — anchor
MINUIT MOINS CINQ — Older Shadows — track
HOLD THE LIGHT — New Signal — anchor
LE MONDE S’ENDORT — New Signal — track

g.text: solid mass = landmark scaffold / set piece
dashed band = corridor that must stay open
larger ring = node protection / no tall props
micro icon = track-level scenic cue around each node
see matrix doc for the full 24-track narrative mapping
city shard -> tall prism / wall fragment
field row -> low strip / stem / band
If the map reads only as color, it fails.
If the user sees places and corridors, it can be extruded.
The SVG is a working blueprint, not a poster.
